The casting is an original adult fashion model. She stands barefoot at a bright ocean waterline with her back toward the camera, her body remaining a clear rear view as she looks toward the horizon, both arms resting naturally by her sides. Use a balanced vertical full-figure frame from a low camera position behind her at knee height. Her legs stay close and softly adducted so the actual upper inner-thigh contours create a small patch of visible beach between them, maintaining believable anatomy. Warm late-afternoon sunlight outlines her hair, shoulders, and calves; gentle surf, pale sand, and a clean horizon complete the polished contemporary K-pop editorial styling.
